description: Call-to-action block with an optional title, optional supporting text, and a button. Two layouts: full-width (centered, bg surface) and inline (flex row). Omit title (and body) to render a standalone button row with no heading — the sanctioned heading-less button pattern.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Optional CTA headline. Omit (along with body) to render a standalone button row with no heading element — the sanctioned heading-less button pattern (issue 294). id/anchor and all style slots still apply. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color. Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored.

eyebrow.description: Optional short kicker/label rendered as a pill above the title. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

body.description: Supporting body text below the title. Inline HTML allowed: a, strong, em, br.

button_text.description: Button label. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

button_url.description: Button destination URL. Accepts an absolute URL (https://...), a site-relative path (/path), an anchor (#id), mailto:, or tel:; a disallowed protocol (javascript:, data:) is rejected at write time because it would render as a dead link.

button2_text.description: Optional SECOND button label, rendered beside the primary button as a secondary action (the hero's button2_text pattern). Leave empty (the default) and no second button is rendered — the CTA is byte-identical to a single-button one. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

button2_url.description: Second button destination URL. Accepts an absolute URL (https://...), a site-relative path (/path), an anchor (#id), mailto:, or tel:; a disallowed protocol (javascript:, data:) is rejected at write time because it would render as a dead link.

button2_variant.description: Second button style — defaults to 'outline' so a primary + secondary pair reads as one filled action and one outlined action. 'primary' = filled accent. 'secondary' = muted surface fill. 'outline' = accent border, transparent fill. 'ghost' = borderless text button. Set via update_component (a prop, not a style slot). Only rendered when button2_text is set.

layout.description: Structural layout. 'full-width' — centered block with surface background. 'inline' — flex row, text left, button right.

theme.description: Background color/tone for this band. 'default' = the band's own default background (no tone override). 'muted' = light tinted surface band (renders the --color-surface background with framing top and bottom borders). 'inverted' = inverted dark background for strong contrast; use 'inverted' for a genuinely dark band.

background_image.description: Optional background image URL. When set, renders as a CSS background-image with a dark overlay. Text automatically uses light colors for contrast.

button_variant.description: Primary button style. 'primary' = filled accent (bare .btn). 'secondary' = muted surface fill. 'outline' = accent border, transparent fill. 'ghost' = borderless text button. Set via update_component (a prop, not a style slot).

--cta-padding-top.description: Top padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm (fluid ~68-80px desktop, ~54px mobile); set an explicit length to override.

--cta-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm; set an explicit length to override.

--cta-bg.description: Background color or gradient. var(--color-surface) is the effective default on the default full-width layout; the inverted theme defaults to var(--color-bg-inverted), and the inline layout and any background_image band default to transparent.

--cta-heading-color.description: Title text color. Defaults to the theme text colour (the inverted and background-image variants supply their own light default). LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ: recolouring every heading on the site is ONE update_design_token write on --color-text, not one slot write per band.

--cta-heading-accent-color.description: Color of the title_accent substring within the title. Ignored unless title_accent is set AND occurs as a substring of title — no accent span is rendered otherwise, so this slot has nothing to colour.

--cta-eyebrow-radius.description: Eyebrow pill corner radius. Set a large value (e.g. 999px) for a fully rounded pill.

--cta-eyebrow-border-width.description: Eyebrow pill border width. Set a non-zero width (with --cta-eyebrow-border-color) for an outlined pill; 0 (default) renders no border.

--cta-eyebrow-border-color.description: Eyebrow pill border color. Takes effect when --cta-eyebrow-border-width is non-zero.

--cta-eyebrow-text-transform.description: Eyebrow pill letter-casing. Default uppercase renders the kicker in caps; set none to keep it as authored (e.g. sentence case), or lowercase / capitalize.

--cta-heading-size.description: Title font size. Defaults to the shared responsive band-heading scale (fluid ~28px mobile to ~42px desktop), which every band heading in the theme routes. LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ from the rest of the site: retuning every band heading at once is ONE update_design_token write on --pp-band-heading-size, not one slot write per band.

--cta-body-color.description: Body text color. var(--color-text-secondary) is the effective default at desktop (>=768px); below 768px it is var(--color-muted). DUAL JOB: on a DARK band (theme inverted, or any background_image band) this same slot is also the LINK ink inside the body, at rest and on hover — so on a dark band the paragraph colour and the link colour cannot differ, and setting it recolours both.

--cta-body-size.description: Body text font size. 1.04rem is the effective default at desktop (>=768px); below 768px it is 1rem

--cta-accent.description: Button RESTING background and border color, shared by both buttons. In the border chain it outranks BOTH the per-button resting fill (--cta-button-bg / --cta-button2-bg) and the site-wide --btn-border-color, so setting it keeps the resting ring on the accent even when the fill is recolored or a global ring token is in play (#564). Only the per-button border slots (--cta-button-border / --cta-button2-border) beat it. This mirrors --cta-accent-hover on hover, so a button's ring cannot change color when the pointer lands.

--cta-accent-hover.description: Button hover BORDER color, mirroring --cta-accent at rest. Does NOT recolor a filled button's visible hover fill on its own — set --cta-button-hover-bg (or --cta-button2-hover-bg) for that. On BOTH buttons this knob outranks the per-button hover fill (--cta-button-hover-bg / --cta-button2-hover-bg), so setting it keeps the hover ring on the accent even when the hover fill is recolored. Because this knob is shared by the pair, setting it is what makes both buttons ring the SAME color; the per-button fill slots are separate, so a fill-only recolor still rings each button with its own fill (#538, #548).

--cta-button-bg.description: Button background color, independent of --cta-accent. Applies whatever button_variant is set to.

--cta-button-hover-bg.description: Button hover background color. On a filled (primary) button it replaces the premium hover gradient with a flat fill, the way --cta-button-bg does for the resting state; pair the two for a button that stays on-brand through the hover. On a PRIMARY button the fill and its ring change instantly rather than animating, so no unchosen in-between color renders; the outline/ghost/secondary variants keep the shared button cross-fade. Applies to the PRIMARY button only — it never reaches the second button, which has --cta-button2-hover-bg.

--cta-button-hover-border.description: Button hover border color. Unset, it falls to --cta-accent-hover, then the global --btn-hover-border-color, then --cta-button-hover-bg, then the global --btn-hover-bg, then the theme default — the same PRECEDENCE ORDER --cta-button2-hover-border uses on the second button (#548, #564). Same order, not necessarily the same color: each button reads its own hover-border and hover-fill slots, so the pair matches wherever the winning link is a SHARED knob (--cta-accent-hover, --btn-hover-border-color, the theme default) and differs wherever it is a per-button one. On a FILLED button a recolored hover fill therefore already carries a matching ring with no border slot set, as --cta-button-border does at rest. Since #564 the REST chain uses this same order, so the ring does not change color when the pointer lands. On background_image bands NEITHER global hover knob is in the chain at all — --btn-hover-border-color left in #564 and --btn-hover-bg in #565 — so that band's ring follows --cta-accent-hover or this button's own --cta-button-hover-bg, and otherwise bottoms out at the measured on-overlay role. Set this (or --cta-accent-hover) only when the hover ring should DIFFER from the hover fill.

--cta-button-shadow.description: Button box shadow on the PRIMARY button only — its per-button counterpart is --cta-button2-shadow, which owns the second button. Set to `none` for a FLAT button (removes the gradient bevel/drop shadow on rest AND hover); pair with --cta-button-bg (a flat color) and --cta-button-color (ink) for a flat primary. Its reach is wider than the name suggests: the elevation chain is keyed on the shared .cta__button class, which the SECOND button carries too, so the only thing that stops this slot repainting button2 is the button2 isolation rule in the cta CSS block — that isolation is load-bearing, not cosmetic. Flattening the primary therefore does NOT flatten button2; use its per-button counterpart --cta-button2-shadow for that.

--cta-button2-bg.description: SECOND button RESTING background color, independent of the primary button (the primary's --cta-button-bg / -color / -shadow / -hover-bg never reach this button, in rest or hover). Applies whatever button2_variant is set to: on a filled (primary) button2 it replaces the premium gradient with a flat fill, exactly as --cta-button-bg does for the primary button. This slot governs the RESTING state only — set --cta-button2-hover-bg for the hover fill, otherwise hover keeps the premium gradient.

--cta-button2-border.description: Second button border color, independent of the primary button. The chain mirrors the primary button's exactly: this slot wins, then --cta-accent, then the site-wide --btn-border-color token, then the fill chain (--cta-button2-bg, then --btn-bg) — so with neither the accent nor a global border token set, a fill-only recolor keeps a matching ring (#564). Set this slot when the ring should differ from the fill, or when --cta-accent or a site-wide --btn-border-color is in play and this button needs its own ring. On background_image bands NEITHER global knob is in the chain at all — --btn-border-color left in #564 and --btn-bg in #565 — so only this slot, --cta-accent and this button's own --cta-button2-bg sit above the measured on-overlay role there.

--cta-button2-color.description: Second button text color, independent of the primary button. This is the safe surface for fixing the second button's contrast on a dark band.

--cta-button2-hover-bg.description: Second button hover background color, independent of the primary button's --cta-button-hover-bg. Applies whatever button2_variant is set to: on a filled (primary) button2 it replaces the premium hover gradient with a flat fill, exactly as --cta-button-hover-bg does for the primary button. Pair with --cta-button2-bg for a second button that stays on-brand through the hover. On a PRIMARY button the fill and its ring change instantly rather than animating, so no unchosen in-between color renders; the outline/ghost/secondary variants keep the shared button cross-fade.

--cta-button2-hover-border.description: Second button hover border color. Unset, it falls to --cta-accent-hover, then the global --btn-hover-border-color, then --cta-button2-hover-bg, then the global --btn-hover-bg, then the theme default — so on a FILLED button2 a recolored hover fill already carries a matching ring with no border slot set, as --cta-button2-border does at rest. Since #564 the REST chain uses this same order, so the ring does not change color when the pointer lands. On background_image bands NEITHER global hover knob is in the chain at all — --btn-hover-border-color left in #564 and --btn-hover-bg in #565 — so that band's ring follows --cta-accent-hover or this button's own --cta-button2-hover-bg, and otherwise bottoms out at the measured on-overlay role. Set this (or --cta-accent-hover) only when the hover ring should DIFFER from the hover fill. The outline/ghost/secondary variants do not follow the hover fill: on those, set this slot explicitly for a ring that tracks a recolored hover fill.

--cta-button2-shadow.description: Second button box shadow — the per-button counterpart of --cta-button-shadow, which owns the PRIMARY button only. button2_variant defaults to `outline`, and every premium bevel rule excludes the outline/ghost/secondary variants, so a DEFAULT button2 already renders no shadow and this slot has nothing to remove; it earns its keep on button2_variant: 'primary', which does carry the bevel. It exists because the button2 isolation rule deliberately blocks the primary elevation from inheriting down, so --cta-button-shadow: none flattens the primary ALONE. Set this to `none` (or a shadow) to control the second button independently; pair with --cta-button2-bg and --cta-button2-color for a fully flat filled pair.

--cta-border-color.description: Top and bottom border color. var(--color-border) is the effective default on the default full-width layout and on the muted theme; the inline layout and any background_image band default to transparent.

--cta-border-width.description: Top and bottom border width. 1px is the effective default on the default full-width layout and on the muted theme; the inline layout and any background_image band default to 0.

--cta-shadow.description: Box shadow of the CTA section (preset var(--shadow-sm|md|lg) or a bounded box-shadow)

--cta-heading-measure.description: Maximum width of the CTA title. On the full-width layout this same value also caps the centered text wrapper, so it governs the title AND body block there. Routes the shared --measure-heading design token (40rem) by default, so retuning that ONE token changes every routed band heading at once; set a length here only when THIS band must differ from the rest of the site.

--cta-heading-margin-bottom.description: Space below the CTA title, before the body line (header rhythm). Lower it to tighten the header, raise it for more separation. Not a band-fusing lever: the button row always renders after the title, so the seam with the band below is closed with --cta-padding-bottom.

--cta-body-measure.description: Maximum width of the CTA body copy. Default "none": the body inherits whatever its wrapper allows, which on the full-width layout is already --cta-heading-measure. Set a length to give the body a SHORTER measure than the title; "none" restores the default.

--cta-overlay-bg.description: Background image overlay color or gradient (e.g. a transparent-to-dark scrim for text legibility over an image)

dark-bold.description: Bold dark background with light text for high-conversion CTAs

accent-framed.description: Accent border framing with rounded corners
